_comment: Tier-2 for fenics hyperelasticity#0. Tier-2 for fenics hyperelasticity#0: signals phrased around dolfinx.nls.petsc.NewtonSolver.solve describe a 0.9-era code path. On dolfinx 0.10.0 that pairing is dead, so hyperelastic Newton diagnostics have to be read off PETSc SNES instead. The fixture builds a compressible Neo-Hookean NonlinearProblem (the standard hyperelasticity residual, P = dPsi/dF via ufl.variable/ufl.diff), then tries NewtonSolver(MPI.COMM_WORLD, problem). Observed signal: a DeprecationWarning "dolfinx.nls.petsc.NewtonSolver is deprecated. Use dolfinx.fem.petsc.NonlinearProblem, a high level interface to PETSc SNES." and then AttributeError: 'NonlinearProblem' object has no attribute 'a'. The supported replacement is exercised in the same run: problem.solve(), then problem.solver (a petsc4py SNES) with getConvergedReason() and getIterationNumber(). Mutation control: T2_MUTATE=1 skips the legacy pairing and only walks the SNES path. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 on dolfinx 0.10.0 / basix 0.10.0 (conda env `fenics`, real scalars); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run. T2_MUTATE=1 removes the pathology and the fixture then fails its own expectations.
expect_in_output: legacy_newtonsolver_pairing_raised=True AttributeError: 'NonlinearProblem' object has no attribute 'a'
dolfinx.nls.petsc.NewtonSolver is deprecated. Use dolfinx.fem.petsc.NonlinearProblem, a high level interface to PETSc SNES.
